    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`This configuration allows you to set default filter values that automatically apply when users open a list, reducing the need for manual filtering and improving user experience. By using QBE (Query By Example) attributes in your datasource definition, you can pre-filter data to show only relevant records based on business requirements.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Display only specific work types by default (e.g., show only “Corrective Maintenance” work orders)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Filter lists to show records for the current user’s location or organization`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Pre-apply status filters to show only active or pending records`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Set default date ranges for time-sensitive data views`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Prerequisites:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Basic understanding of Maximo datasources and object structures`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Access to modify application XML files`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Knowledge of the field names in your target object structure`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Understanding of QBE operators (in, =, !=, <, >, etc.)`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`Implementation`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Add QBE definition to datasource (Declarative Approach)`}</h3>
    <p>{`The declarative approach uses XML to define the default filter directly in the datasource configuration. This is the recommended method as it keeps the filter definition visible in the app.xml and doesn’t require custom JavaScript code.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Location in app.xml:`}</strong>{`
Find your datasource definition (or datasource-override) and add the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`qbe`}</inlineCode>{` structure within it.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`XML Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource-override id="todaywoassignedDS" object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL">
  <!-- Define the QBE filter with one or more fields -->
  <qbe id="listQbe">
    <!-- Filter work orders to show only Corrective Maintenance (CM) -->
    <qbe-field 
      name="worktype" 
      operator="in" 
      value="['CM']" 
      id="fieldlistQbe"
    />
  </qbe>
</maximo-datasource-override>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`QBE Operators:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`in`}</inlineCode>{` - Match any value in the array (e.g., `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`['CM', 'EM']`}</inlineCode>{`)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`=`}</inlineCode>{` - Exact match (e.g., `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`'APPR'`}</inlineCode>{`)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`!=`}</inlineCode>{` - Not equal to`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`<`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`>`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`<=`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`>=`}</inlineCode>{` - Comparison operators for numbers and dates`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`like`}</inlineCode>{` - Wildcard search (use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`%`}</inlineCode>{` for wildcards)`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Important Notes:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`QBE supports both EXACT and WILDCARD searches`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`For multiple values, use the `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`in`}</inlineCode>{` operator with an array: `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`['CM', 'EM', 'PM']`}</inlineCode></li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`String values must be enclosed in quotes within the array`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`id`}</inlineCode>{` attribute on qbe-field is required for proper component identification`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Expected Result:`}</strong>{`
When the list loads, it will automatically display only work orders with work type “CM” (Corrective Maintenance).`}</p>

    <h3>{`Step 2: Set QBE programmatically (Alternative Approach)`}</h3>
    <p>{`Alternatively, you can set QBE filters programmatically during datasource initialization. This approach is useful when filter values need to be calculated dynamically or depend on runtime conditions.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`JavaScript Implementation:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Custom Application Logic
 * Sets default QBE filters when datasources are initialized
 */
class AppCustomizations {
  /**
   * Called when the application is initialized
   * @param {Object} app - The application instance
   */
  applicationInitialized(app) {
    this.app = app;
  }

  /**
   * Called when each datasource is initialized
   * @param {Object} datasource - The datasource being initialized
   */
  onDatasourceInitialized(datasource) {
    // Check if this is the datasource we want to filter
    if (datasource.name === 'todaywoassignedDS') {
      // Set QBE filter for work type
      // Parameters: fieldName, operator, value(s)
      datasource.setQBE('worktype', 'in', ['CM', 'EM']);
      
      // You can set multiple QBE filters
      // datasource.setQBE('status', '=', 'APPR');
      // datasource.setQBE('priority', '>', 2);
    }
  }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Important Notes:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`setQBE`}</inlineCode>{` method takes three parameters: field name, operator, and value(s)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`For the `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`in`}</inlineCode>{` operator, pass an array of values`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`For other operators, pass a single value`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Multiple `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`setQBE`}</inlineCode>{` calls can be chained to create complex filters`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`This approach executes before the datasource loads data`}</li>
    </ul>

The list will display only work orders with work type “CM” or “EM” when it loads.`}</p>
